title: Cross-Variant Tooling Parity Scorer and Ops Runbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a lightweight, automated compatibility scorer and operational runbook that grades model variants for tokenizer/context/tooling parity and ties score thresholds into smart routing policies. This ticket creates: (1) a parity 'scorecard' that quantifies tokenizer and KV/cache/context compatibility across model variants; (2) a nightly scanner that updates the scorecard and emits metrics; (3) an ops runbook and gating guidance for automating fallback and for manual remediation when parity drops below thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable scorecard (CSV + JSON export) exists that reports per-variant scores for: tokenizer tokenization delta, max-context bytes parity, KV cache checkpoint compatibility, and tooling/IO contract checks.
Nightly job runs and publishes score updates to the metrics dashboard; metric names documented and visible in Console (parity.variant.score, parity.variant.alert).
Default routing policy updated to treat variants with score >= 90 as 'drop-in compatible' and variants with score < 70 as 'no-auto-fallback' unless opt-in via feature flag.
Ops runbook (playbook) created with triage steps, common remediation commands, example GitHub PR templates, and escalation matrix for SRE/Research/TF teams.
Integration test that simulates tokenization mismatch (synthetic inputs) triggers score delta and produces an alert in CI for regression detection.
Documentation links to the score methodology and explainers added to the model onboarding checklist in Confluence/Drive.
plan: Define scoring rubric (weights for tokenizer delta, context parity, KV checkpoint compatibility, tooling contract tests).
Implement tokenizer delta runner using a corpus of representative prompts and canonical BPE/byte models; compute normalized edit/token differences.
Add context parity tests: export model max-context and validate byte-level equivalence on serialized context boundaries.
Create tooling/IO contract smoke tests: load/save KV checkpoints, run fast inference path, ensure signatures match (shapes/types).
Build nightly pipeline (Airflow/Cron) that runs scorers, writes results to S3 and emits Prometheus metrics.
Hook score thresholds into smart routing config; add feature flag to toggle threshold enforcement per namespace.
Author ops runbook with play-by-play for a failing variant score, including rollback, canarying, and issue templates.
Ship integration test and add to pre-release CI gate for runtime-2.3 branch.
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created. Initial rubric draft attached to Confluence (link below). Assigned to Marcus for implementation. Estimated 5 points.
2026-03-03: Design sync with Applied ML - agreed to weight tokenizer delta 40%, context parity 30%, KV/tooling 30%. Decided to keep scorer deterministic and reproducible across regions.

2026-03-05: Prototype tokenizer delta runner completed in feature branch; initial run across core variants produced scores in range 55-98. Noted two variants with canonical tokenization drift due to byte-level normalization change.
2026-03-07: Nightly job scaffolded in infra repo; initial Prometheus metrics emit working on staging. Draft of ops runbook started, needs runbook reviewer from SRE.
2026-03-08: Feature flag (parity.enforce.routing) added to console config with default false for canary rollout. Need to finalize CI integration test and write dashboard panels.
risks: False positives: a conservative scorer could prevent safe fallbacks and increase latency/cost when top-tier variants are unavailable.
Scorer maintenance overhead: tokenizer changes or tokenizer merges may require frequent rubric updates; need clear ownership.
Cross-region determinism: small normalization differences in tokenizers per build could create inconsistent scores across regions; will normalize on model artifact SHA.
next_steps: Finalize rubric doc and get sign-off from Applied ML and Runtime leads by 2026-03-10.
Merge tokenizer runner prototype after adding sampling deterministic seed and desktop test cases.
Complete Prometheus metric naming and Dashboard panels; schedule SRE review for runbook.
